title: Winners of Next Manga Award 2026 Announced
content: The winners of Kadokawa 's annual Next Manga Award were announced on Wednesday. The awards ceremony was streamed on Niconico on the same day. Out of the 7,952 titles that were submitted for the award, 100 titles (40 print manga, 60 web manga) were nominated by a special commitee for the final round of voting.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm Anime Gets 2nd Season
content: The staff for the television anime of Hiromu Arakawa 's Daemons of the Shadow Realm ( Yomi no Tsugai ) manga announced after the final episode of the first season aired on Sunday that the series will receive a second season.

title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm Season 2 Announced With Teaser Video
content: Daemons of the Shadow Realm Season 2 was officially announced immediately after the first season’s finale finished airing in Japan. Studio BONES FILM is in charge of the animation, with the anime concluding after two consecutive cours and a total of 24 episodes. It’s streaming on Crunchyroll.
